summary: Brazil's dual-nationality row is now cited from an archived copy of the same amendment.

resolution.note: The Câmara page now returns HTTP 404 and planalto.gov.br redirects automated clients to its homepage. Source ladder step 4: cited from the Internet Archive copy of 22 July 2026, which still reads "II - fizer pedido expresso de perda da nacionalidade brasileira perante autoridade brasileira competente" (Brazilian nationality is lost only on an express request). brazil.dualNationalityAtHome stays "allowed".
